title: 第200章 66号牢房第199章 告知艾米娅
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
“是”
维罗娜站了起来，翠绿色的高马尾随之微微晃动，璀璨的双眸中充满着好奇与紧张
狄曼列握住手杖，起身来到维罗娜身边，轻声开口：“不要反抗，我带你传送”
维罗娜点了点头：“好的”
下一刻，恐怖的魔力波动闪过，维罗娜只觉得自己被无数目光监视着，接着眼前便陷入了短暂的黑暗
随着狄曼列与维罗娜的身影消失在这里，办公室内也恢复了安静
.......
几乎就是二人离开的瞬间，第五监区深处的某间牢房中，一双冰冷的双眸猛的亮了起来
幽蓝色的魔力光芒顺着金属管道流动，不断注入着金属与生物组织交错的身体
很快，这具人形抬起了仿若尖兵机甲般的机械头颅，缓缓站了起来
一个又一个模块亮起，这具尖兵机甲也彻底进入了复苏状态
咔啦─────
金属关节活动的声音响起，这具如同科幻小说走出来的人形装甲熟练的拔掉身上的魔力管道，随手打开了牢房的铁栏
祂的每一步都如同律法般冰冷沉重，让人喘不过气
走出牢房，还有清醒意识的犯人全都将目光投了过去
66号牢房，犯人信息：【猎人】
身体透明的星空圣女一脸茫然的拿着维罗娜巡查时给她的牛肉干，接着表情变的无比惊恐：“这个怪物怎么逃出来的？！”
尖兵机甲没有立刻离开，而是调整了一下狰狞金属手臂内侧的光刀与链刃，似乎是在校准参数
冰冷的魔导眼缓缓扫视过第五监区内的所有犯人，金属人形再次迈开步伐，朝第五监区外走去
走到入口时，天使索菲莉与座天使忍不住看向了祂，但都没有多说什么，只是目光注视着祂离开了这里

直到入口再次关闭，座天使才重新翻了一页书，密密麻麻的眼球不规则的眨动：“这个东西，大概率是狄曼列的制造的”
“嗯？”，天使索菲莉疑惑的歪了歪头：“小座你不知道吗？它就是狄曼列审判官制造的呀？”
座天使的眼球全部顿了一瞬：“你怎么知道？”
“狄曼列审判官说的呀，他还在这里穿过呢”，天使索菲莉回忆了一下：“狄曼列审判官说这个是装甲，是.......男人的浪漫？”
座天使的声音中多了一丝疑惑：“我怎么不记得？”
“你那时候刚拿到这本书的第一册”
“那没事了”
.......
.......
同一时间，鸢尾花监狱广场上的赫尔莎与露诺也下意识的抬起了头，看向典狱长办公室的方向
赫尔莎有些不舍的开口：“典狱长走了呢”
“嗯，走了”，露诺点了点头
一旁的柯蕾忍不住开口：“你们两个是能感受到传送魔法的波动吗？这么厉害”
“嗯？”，赫尔莎看向柯蕾，轻轻摇了摇头：“不是，只是感受不到典狱长的气息了，典狱长在附近的话我身体会有反应的”
柯蕾和莎娜对视一眼，同时竖起了大拇指：
“更厉害了”
content_en:
"Yes"
Verona stood up, her emerald green pony tail swaying slightly, her bright eyes full of curiosity and nervousness.
Diamanlie held the cane, stood up and came to Verona, and said softly: "Don't resist, I will take you to teleport."
Verona nodded: "Okay"
The next moment, terrifying magic fluctuations flashed through. Verona felt that she was being monitored by countless eyes, and then her eyes fell into a brief darkness.
As Diamanlie and Verona disappeared here, the office also returned to silence.
.......
Almost at the moment the two left, in a cell deep in the fifth prison area, a pair of cold eyes suddenly lit up.
The faint blue magic light flows along the metal pipes, constantly injecting into the body where metal and biological tissue are intertwined.
Soon, the humanoid raised its mechanical head like a mecha and stood up slowly.
One module after another lights up, and this elite mecha has completely entered a state of recovery.
Click─────
The sound of metal joints moving sounded. This humanoid armor that looked like something out of a science fiction novel skillfully pulled out the magic pipes on its body and opened the iron bars of the cell.
Every step He takes is as cold and heavy as the law, making people breathless
After walking out of the cell, all the prisoners who were still conscious turned their attention to it.
Cell No. 66, prisoner information: [Hunter]
The starry sky saint with a transparent body held the beef jerky given to her by Verona during the inspection with a blank look on her face, and then her expression turned extremely horrified: "How did this monster escape?!"
The vanguard mecha did not leave immediately, but adjusted the light knife and chain blade on the inside of the ferocious metal arm, seeming to be calibrating the parameters.
The cold magic eyes slowly scanned all the prisoners in the fifth prison area. The metal figure took another step and walked towards the outside of the fifth prison area.
When they walked to the entrance, the angel Sophie and the other angels couldn't help but look at Him, but they didn't say anything, they just watched Him leave.
It wasn't until the entrance was closed again that the angel turned another page of the book, his densely packed eyeballs blinking irregularly: "This thing is most likely made by Demanlie."
"Huh?" Angel Sophie tilted her head in confusion: "Don't you know, little seat? It was made by Judge Diamenlie?"
The angel's eyes all paused for a moment: "How do you know?"
"Judge Diamanlie said it, he still wore it here." Angel Sophie recalled: "Judge Diamanlie said this is armor, is... a man's romance?"
There was a hint of doubt in the angel's voice: "Why don't I remember?"
"You just got the first volume of this book at that time."
"That's okay"
.......
.......
At the same time, Helsa and Luna in the Iris Prison Square also subconsciously raised their heads and looked in the direction of the warden's office.
Helsa said with some reluctance: "The warden is gone."
"Well, let's go." Luno nodded.
Ke Lei on the side couldn't help but said: "Can you two feel the fluctuations of teleportation magic? It's so powerful."
"Huh?" Helsa looked at Ke Lei and shook her head slightly: "No, I just can't feel the warden's breath anymore. My body will react if the warden is nearby."
Ke Lei and Shana looked at each other and gave a thumbs up at the same time:
“More awesome”
